column2: Picker Active checkbox defaults to unchecked; toggling is a client-side filter - no location-lookup server request fires on toggle
column11:
Opening the picker fires a location-lookup API call (baseline check). Toggling the Active checkbox is a client-side filter - no location-lookup API call fires on toggle (server ignores the activeOnly parameter; both checked and unchecked return the same 2,651 active-only location set).
